plugins.name: to-hexagonal-architecture
plugins.description: Analyze an existing codebase in any language or framework and produce a phased, zero-breaking-change refactoring plan to migrate it to Hexagonal Architecture (Ports and Adapters).

plugins.name: jira-ticket-creator
plugins.description: Creates well-structured Jira tickets (defaulting to Story) via the Atlassian MCP server. Gathers codebase/technical context, enforces repository naming conventions, separates Acceptance Criteria from DoD, and generates all ticket content in Spanish.
